description: Get the places Houski holds property data for, as a hierarchy of countries, provinces (or states or regions), cities and communities, with links and slugs. Billed per location returned, a small fraction of a cent each. This is the source of every country_abbreviation, province_abbreviation, city and community the other tools take. There is no paging and every matching location comes back, so scope every call: resolution=country and resolution=province are small, while resolution=city or community with no country_abbreviation and province_abbreviation returns every city of every country in one very large response. Naming a level requires naming its parents, and the endpoint returns a 400 saying so if you skip one. filters keeps only the places where at least one property matches, which is the cheapest way to check coverage. A call with filters must name exactly one country, with country_abbreviation, or something narrower inside one country, or it is refused with a 400: country_abbreviation=ca with resolution=country and filters=["parcel_number_regex=."] returns Canada only when it holds parcel numbers. Several countries take one call each. A call with no filters needs no place.

city.description: City name. Requires country_abbreviation and province_abbreviation, and the endpoint returns a 400 if either is missing.

community.description: Community/neighborhood name. Requires country_abbreviation, province_abbreviation and city, and the endpoint returns a 400 if any is missing.

country_abbreviation.description: Country abbreviation (for example "CA"). Pass it with province_abbreviation on anything finer than resolution=province, or the response covers the whole country.

filters.description: Filters that keep only the locations holding at least one matching property, in the "field_operator=value" form. "<field>_regex=." keeps the places where some property has a value for that field, which is how to check a field's coverage by country or region. A call with filters must also name exactly one country, with country_abbreviation, or something narrower inside one country, so several countries take one call each.

flat.description: Return flat format instead of nested (default: false). Flat is roughly four times larger, because each row repeats the whole country and province block instead of nesting under it, and carries a null key for every level below the resolution. Prefer nested unless you specifically want one row per location.

price_quote.description: Return the cost of this request without billing it or returning data

province_abbreviation.description: Province, state or region abbreviation (for example "AB"). Requires country_abbreviation. The two together keep a resolution=city call to one province instead of every city of the country.

resolution.description: Depth: "country", "province", "city", or "community" (default). This is the main size lever. With no country_abbreviation and province_abbreviation, stay on "country" or "province".

name: location_endpoint
